purpose: Join of existing registered winning tuples, frozen architectures, final phase records, resource profiles and A2 metrics. No training, inference, metric recomputation or statistical analysis.

scope.classical_resource_values: not measured; excluded rather than filled with zero

field_scopes.configuration: Winner matches registered CSV by model and slot; TiDE uses its published R0-v2 domain. Frozen trial numeric values are cross-checked against the applicable domain.
field_scopes.warmup_fraction: Absent in a fixed recipe means zero according to the recorded training policy; TiDE published domain has fixed zero warmup.
field_scopes.fixed_epochs: Copied from final phase_resources.csv stage=final; all six seeds have identical recorded epochs within each model and phase. Blank auxiliary epochs mean phase not applicable.
field_scopes.parameters: Deployed predictor only; SAE auxiliary decoders excluded.
field_scopes.core_forward_flops: Observed core count, not full-operation FLOPs; 2 FLOPs per MAC; excludes FFT, activations, normalization, pooling, bias and memory movement.
field_scopes.final_phase_seconds: Published mean and sample SD across six final seeds. SAE includes AE1, AE2 and supervised phase; excludes full HPO, controller and persisted final scoring.
field_scopes.latency: Published mean of six seed-level median CUDA-event forward latencies, 32 warmup and 100 repetitions, batch 1 resident input; excludes transfer, preprocessing, model load and serving.
field_scopes.primary_RMSE: A2 mean of six individual-seed RMSE values on 608 common dates, not RMSE of an ensemble. SD describes seed variation conditional on the same observed chronology. Per-seed JSON follows final_seeds_json.
field_scopes.full_selection_seconds: Unknown; retained as an empty field, not zero.
field_scopes.author_source: Author repository and commit copied from frozen architecture when recorded. Empty fields remain unknown/not separately recorded. DOI and adaptation details remain in linked catalogue/source sections.
field_scopes.source_result_sha256: Hash of the result record bound to the frozen architecture example; not a new hash over all six checkpoints.

verification: Static identity and field checks only. No fits, inference, FLOPs probes, bootstrap, power calculations or hypothesis tests were executed.
